notes.title: Update (v1.0.5) Details
notes.content:
[p]◆Feature Additions / Changes
・Online Ranking Restart and Past Ranking Viewing Added
  With the Nintendo Switch version release, rankings will restart from this version.
  Past rankings from ver1.0.5 and earlier can be viewed by switching screens.
・GamePad Key Configuration Added
  When using non-official controllers,
  in-game button displays may not appear correctly.
・Improved mouse + keyboard controls to allow movement with arrow keys
・Adjusted visual effects for certain item uses
・Updated Help section
[/p][p]◆Bug Fixes
・Fixed an issue where saved data created after using the “Technique Compendium” to learn techniques
　would retain the learned techniques when creating a new save file.
[/p][p]◆Notes
・To ensure compatibility, please make sure to apply this update.
[/p]

notes.title: Update (v1.0.4) Supported content.
notes.content:
◆Fixes for bugs 
- Fixed a problem where teddies sometimes do not disappear from the item box when used 
- Fixed a problem where the description of the shajabble is different from the actual performance 
- Fixed a problem with the direction when throwing an item.

Remarks 
- Please make sure to reflect the update as we cannot guarantee the operation.

notes.title: Next bug fixes and online ranking data
notes.content:
We would like to report the following details.

◆Next bug fixes 
- Fixing a problem where teddies sometimes do not disappear from the item field when used 
- Fixing a problem where the description of the shajabble differs from the actual performance 
- Fixing a problem with the direction when throwing items.

We have been able to reproduce the above problems and are currently working on a fix.
We hope you will give us some time to fix the issue as we are planning to update the game shortly.

◆About the online ranking

A new online ranking will be launched on the 
Steam version in time for the launch of the Nintendo Switch version scheduled for summer 2025.

The new online ranking will be divided into the following categories: - Old ranking: Switch version

Old ranking: records before the launch of the Switch version 
- New ranking: records registered after the launch of the Switch version.

From now on, all records will be registered in the new ranking.
The old rankings will only be viewable (on a separate screen).

The rankings for the Steam and Switch versions are separate and will not be merged.

notes.title: アップデート（v1.0.3）対応内容
notes.content:
◆対応内容
・一部環境、スペックにおいて発生していたエラーポップアップに対する対策
・クリア後のエンディングが表示されず、真っ暗の画面のままになるときがある問題への対策

◆備考
必ず最新アップデートを反映して頂くようお願い致します。

notes.title: Update (v1.0.2) Supported content
notes.content:
Contents of support
The addition of a MAC OS version.
Fixed a bug that sometimes causes double staircases to be descended.
Fixed a bug of the card of silence and the card of salon pess.

After the update, you will not be able to send rankings from previous versions (v1.0.1).
Please make sure to play the game with the latest update.
